steps.title: Create an identity
steps.note: Twelve words are generated on your device and the keypair is derived from them. A PIN encrypts those words at rest. Write them down: nothing else can bring the account back.

steps.title: Share your address
steps.note: null: followed by your public key, with a three-word callsign and a PSEUDO#0000 handle. Send it however you like, it is public by design.

steps.title: Ask, and be accepted
steps.note: Paste their address in Discover and send. The request waits on the relay if they are offline, sealed, and lands when they come back.

steps.title: Check the four words
steps.note: Once the channel is up, both sides see four words derived from the session keys. Read them aloud. If they match, nobody is in the middle.
